questions: Can we move stones from bag A to bag B if bag A currently has zero stones? (i.e., is the operation allowed only when the source bag has at least one stone?)
Is there any limit on how many stones can be moved in a single operation? (e.g., must move exactly one, or any positive integer up to the current count in bag A?)
Are the bags distinguishable for the final XOR? (i.e., is the XOR taken over the multiset of final stone counts, or over the specific bag order given?)
Can we choose the same bag for both A and B in an operation? (i.e., moving stones from a bag to itself?)
Is the operation allowed to be performed zero times? (i.e., is the initial configuration included in the possible values?)
Are negative numbers of stones allowed in any bag during the process? (i.e., can we move more stones than are present in bag A?)
Is there any constraint on the total number of stones being conserved? (i.e., must the sum of all B_i equal the sum of all A_i?)
Can we choose bags A and B in any order? (i.e., is moving from bag A to bag B considered the same as moving from bag B to bag A if we swap labels?)
